reason_for_new_version: Candidate 1 failed its predeclared 2020-03 stress sanity because emergency policy-support components overwhelmed simultaneously severe observed financial conditions. Candidate 1 remains frozen and rejected; Candidate 2 changes the aggregation rule explicitly rather than retuning Candidate 1.
availability_rule: Observation month t becomes eligible at calendar month-end t+1.

components.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago via FRED
Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System via FRED
Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Kim-Wright term-premium model, via FRED
Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System H.4.1 via FRED
components.monthly_transform: last observation in calendar month, then 3-month percent change

aggregation.structural_support_z: equal-weight arithmetic mean of the four signed component z-scores
aggregation.economic_rule: Broad observed financial conditions are a binding cap. Policy easing can improve the support backdrop, but cannot make effective Funding more supportive than the financial conditions actually being observed.

fixed_initial_gates.legacy_current_direction: The latest candidate eligible at 2026-07-31 must be compared with the preserved legacy Funding regime RESTRICTIVE; disagreement is reported, never tuned away.
fixed_initial_gates.candidate_1_regression: Candidate 1 frozen history/result must remain unchanged and auditable.
fixed_initial_gates.usefulness: Even a directional PASS does not permit promotion. Candidate 2 must next pass a separately frozen narrow usefulness/conviction gate without parameter, horizon or asset search.

diagnostics_not_in_score: Structural-support score is retained as a diagnostic beside the effective score.
SOFR minus IORB remains a prospective/live diagnostic and is not backfilled into the score.
Treasury plumbing remains deferred unless a later versioned test shows material incremental decision value.
guardrails: Funding remains an OVERLAY and cannot overwrite Money Core.
Candidate 2 is a new version created after Candidate 1 failure; Candidate 1 is not rewritten.
Do not change weights, z-score window, publication lag, regime thresholds or the min-cap rule merely to improve validation results.
Current revised FRED history is research evidence, not a point-in-time vintage backtest.
Promotion requires reproducible provenance, the narrow usefulness gate, scheduled refresh and Data Health integration.
